_comment: Manual overrides for analytes whose LOINC assignment the automatic exact/fuzzy matcher gets wrong. Key = analyte name as produced by parse_lab_values (i.e. exactly what appears in the 'missing_loinc' / 'fuzzy_matches' sections of the problem report). Value = a LOINC_NUM string to force that match, or null to state 'this analyte has no LOINC, do not try to match it'. Entries here always win over exact and fuzzy matching. Use 'Name@specimen' (e.g. 'Osmolality@serum') to pin different LOINCs for the same name in different specimens; it beats the bare 'Name' key. Remove the _comment key before shipping if something ever reads this strictly.
